LESSON: COLLAGE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Creating and Execution
Topic 1.5: Collage
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Collage, part of Creating and Execution in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: What materials can be used to make a collage?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Collage together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: as the learner work collaboratively to paste the different materials on the outlined

forms,

• Self-efficacy: as the learner express themselves about their artwork during display sessions

Values:
• Responsibility: learner reusing recycling waste materials from the environment,

• Love: learners show and talk about own and others’ collage, work

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life skills: Teacher to help learners develop self-awareness and self-esteem through display of their work and guiding them to

express their feelings, ideas and emotions.

17

Link to other learning areas:

• Environmental Activities: learner use of locally available materials emphasises on use of non-degradable, recycled, reused,

waste materials.

• Language activities: the word Collage can be included in the vocabulary.

Suggested learning resources

Locally available materials such as papers, old newspapers, magazines, sticks, reference books, relevant virtual sites, flash

cards, glue, scissors, pencils, video clips showing collage making resource persons
